newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam to sell 50 bln dong T-notes on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam to sell 50 bln dong T-notes on Wednesday.

text.p: Vietnam will auction 50 billion dong ($4.28 million) worth of one-year Treasury notes on Wednesday, an official at the State Bank of Vietnam said on Tuesday.
At the last sale of government paper, on May 7, the central bank sold 50 billion dong worth of one-year Treasury notes to domestic institutions at an annual interest rate of 12.00 percent.
The government has held seven Treasury paper auction so far this year, through which a total of 229.4 billion dong worth of Treasury stock has been issued. (US$1=11,658 dong)
